lines.zh: 我半透明的身体浮着过来。
lines.en: My half-seen body drifts toward you.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，空气都没动。
lines.en: Where I pass, the air stays still.
The flames do not stir as I pass.

lines.zh: 我从火里走过来，火没照出我的样子。
lines.en: I walk through fire and it doesn't show me.

lines.zh: 我贴着下界的岩壁滑行。
lines.en: I slide along the Nether's rock walls.

lines.zh: 我飘过岩浆，脚下没起烟。
lines.en: I drift over the lava; no smoke rises.

lines.zh: 我一步一步靠近，没有影子。
lines.en: I close in, and I cast no shadow.

lines.zh: 岩壁的热浪扯着我的边。
lines.en: The rock's heat waves tug at my edges.

lines.zh: 我从岩浆上走过去，鞋底没烧着。
lines.en: I cross lava and my soles don't scorch.
I move forward as if blown.

lines.zh: 我的骨头在皮下隐约可见。
lines.en: My bones show faintly under the skin.
I pass through smoke and it doesn't part.
I stop in the dark without a sound.
Only my eyes are solid.
The heat around me passes through.

lines.zh: 我的牙在咧着，一直这样。
lines.en: My teeth are bared, and stay that way.

lines.zh: 你在墙那边，我听得很清楚。
lines.en: You are on the far side of the wall; I hear you clearly.
My face turns to you; my body does not.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在你身后，不是我。
lines.en: A shadow falls behind you; it isn't mine.
I count the gaps between your breaths.
The firelight can't get through me.

lines.zh: 我半个身子在一堵墙里。
lines.en: Half of me is inside a wall.

lines.zh: 你朝我这边看，可你看不清。
lines.en: You look my way, but you can't see clearly.
Your weapon moved first.
I'm at your flank.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛总是比我慢一步。
lines.en: Your eyes are always a beat behind.
I bare my teeth, all of them.
Do you hear me speaking?

lines.zh: 我离你这么近，你还不知道。
lines.en: I'm this close and you still don't know.

lines.zh: 你把灯举高，我退了一步。
lines.en: You raise the light and I step back.

lines.zh: 我一直等着你转身的那一刻。
lines.en: I keep waiting for the moment you turn.
Can you feel the cold?

lines.zh: 我散开一点，又慢慢聚拢。
lines.en: I come apart a little and slowly gather.
The blow thins me a great deal.
I press myself into the stone.
I flicker so hard I can barely stand.
I don't cry out, yet you hear it.

lines.zh: 我压住形状，不让自己散掉。
lines.en: I hold my shape so I won't scatter.
That one landed solid — and it hurts.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己，缺了一块。
lines.en: I look down; a piece of me is missing.
I drift back a stretch.

lines.zh: 我重新抓住自己的轮廓。
lines.en: I catch hold of my own outline again.

lines.zh: 我早就不需要吃任何东西了。
lines.en: I stopped needing to eat long ago.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西对我没用。
lines.en: What's in your hand is useless to me.
I go past it without stopping.
I'm not hungry; I only want to follow you.
You hold it up and I laugh.
The smell is too faint to catch.
My hand passes through it.
You'd better keep that for yourself.

lines.zh: 你的体温比那东西好看。
lines.en: Your body heat is more interesting than that.
Move it; it's hiding your face.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我散了一下又合上。
lines.en: You charge and I scatter, then close.
That didn't move me.
I pass through half of you.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你打了个寒战。
lines.en: We meet, and you shiver.
My shape breaks up for an instant.
I back half a step and re-form.
You didn't hit anything solid.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方起了寒气。
lines.en: A chill follows where I've passed.
I go around you, along the wall.
I settle and watch you.
Neither of us is clearly visible.
Her outline holds steadier than mine.

lines.zh: 我们在同一处暗里停住。
lines.en: We stop in the same dark.

lines.zh: 我们靠在一起，没有声音。
lines.en: We come together without a sound.

lines.zh: 两只鬼并排飘着，谁都没声。
lines.en: Two ghosts drift side by side, neither speaking.
We part slowly, then near again.

lines.zh: 这一带的热气把我们包住。
lines.en: The heat wraps us both.
Not even the air moved when she left.

lines.zh: 她的手指穿过我的手掌。
lines.en: Her fingers pass through my palm.
Then only I am left here.

lines.zh: 我伸手，它从指间滑过去。
lines.en: I reach, and it slips through my fingers.
It takes three tries.
It goes cold in my hand.
I look at your face through it.
I drop it and hear nothing.
It passes through my palm.
I grip and smoke leaks between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我拿着走了一段，忘了扔哪。
lines.en: I carry it a while, then forget where.
It's mine for a moment.
I let go; it lands past the wall.
You moved, and I locked on.

lines.zh: 我的牙缝里挤出一点气。
lines.en: A little breath hisses through my teeth.
I bare my teeth at you.
I needn't run; I'll arrive.

lines.zh: 你挡不住看不见的东西。
lines.en: You can't block what you can't see.
I drift toward you.
My outline starts to fade.
In this heat I hide best.
I want to be close before you notice.
My teeth click shut once.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸一直在我耳朵里。
lines.en: Your breathing is always in my hearing.
Once locked on, I don't let go.
I come from your blind side.
Still standing there — good.
One step puts me behind you.
I follow you without a sound.

lines.zh: 你数到第二下，我换了位置。
lines.en: By your second count I have moved.
You sweep the light over and I retreat.
Your steps are getting quicker.
I'm beside you, not behind.

lines.zh: 你听见脚步了，可那不是你的。
lines.en: You hear steps, and they aren't yours.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙，跟你一个速度。
lines.en: I keep to the wall at your pace.
You've started calling for help.

lines.zh: 这里有回声，我的声音混在里面。
lines.en: There are echoes here, and my voice joins them.

lines.zh: 我从烟里走出来，你才看见。
lines.en: Only when I step out of the smoke do you see me.
You've backed to the lava's edge.
Now you can't retreat.

lines.zh: 我把手抬起来，透明的那种。
lines.en: I raise a hand, the transparent kind.

lines.zh: 你转了两圈，找错了方向。
lines.en: You turn twice and pick the wrong way.
I'm directly ahead of you.
You finally see me.
I open my hands slowly.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，武器也跟着。
lines.en: Your hand shakes, and your weapon with it.
I laugh, very softly.
You won't dodge this one.

lines.zh: 我伸手抓过去，你没挡住。
lines.en: I reach and you don't block it.
My teeth sink into your shoulder guard.
That blow carries a chill.

lines.zh: 你退开，我的轮廓又散了。
lines.en: You back off and my outline scatters.
I reach out of the wall.
You swing, and the blade passes through me.
I press against your back.
My fingers dig in.
Five cold spots stay on you.
I pull back and re-form.
You're swinging wildly now.
That's what I was waiting for.

lines.zh: 我用胸口贴上你的后背。
lines.en: I press my chest against your back.

lines.zh: 铁板挡得住刀，挡不住冷。
lines.en: Plate stops a blade, not the cold.

lines.zh: 我咬了两下，第二下更深。
lines.en: Two bites, the second deeper.
Your knees buckle and you go down.

lines.zh: 我低下头，正好能看见你。
lines.en: I lower my head and there you are.
You're still moving; then again.
The fire dims for a moment.
I rise out of the rock wall.

lines.zh: 我没有落地，就那样停着。
lines.en: I never land; I simply hang there.

lines.zh: 下界的热气让我的轮廓更淡。
lines.en: The Nether's heat thins my outline.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼睛，你不该看见的。
lines.en: I open my eyes; you shouldn't be seeing this.

lines.zh: 我试着走了一步，没有声音。
lines.en: I try a step and there's no sound.
The smoke gathers toward me.

lines.zh: 我先学会了怎么不被人看见。
lines.en: First I learn how not to be seen.
I bare my teeth and keep smiling.

lines.zh: 这具身体的热气引我上来。
lines.en: The heat of a living body draws me up.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓先在墙上聚形。
lines.en: My outline gathers on the wall first.
It's dark here — just right.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在你身后的墙上。
lines.en: My shadow lands on the wall behind you.
I walk toward that small light.

lines.zh: 火能烧到我，这让我意外。
lines.en: Fire can burn me — that surprises me.

lines.zh: 我落下去，摔得形都散了。
lines.en: I fall, and the landing scatters my shape.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我的形状被冲开。
lines.en: Water pours in and washes my shape apart.
The blast scatters me entirely.

lines.zh: 一根箭穿过我，留了个洞。
lines.en: An arrow passes through and leaves a hole.
That light makes me visible.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我也会淡。
lines.en: I don't eat, and I can still fade.

lines.zh: 雷照亮了我，整片都看得见。
lines.en: Lightning lights me up for all to see.

lines.zh: 什么都没有，我连形状都抓不住。
lines.en: There's nothing here; I can't even hold a shape.
